info.description: The Hotel Room Inventory Management API provides endpoints to efficiently access and manage the inventory of hotel rooms. This API allows users to retrieve a detailed list of available rooms, along with their current status and other relevant information. It is designed for hotel management teams, booking platforms, and other stakeholders needing real-time data on room availability. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their booking processes, improve customer satisfaction, and streamline inventory management.

get.description: This API endpoint allows users to fetch the current inventory of rooms available. It provides details such as room type, availability status, and other relevant information to assist users in making informed decisions.
